signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.phoneHint: The number you registered with, for example 077 123 4567.
signIn.forgotten: Forgotten your password? Ask a librarian at your branch to reset it.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.lead: You will stay signed in here; every other device will be signed out.
changePassword.mustBody: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose a new one before you continue.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.

lead.member: What needs your attention, and your books.

home.fewerThanTwoBody: The library needs at least two active super admins, so that one can always help the other.

staff.title: Staff
staff.leadSuper: Every librarian and super admin. Accounts are never deleted; deactivate one to stop it being used.
staff.name: Full name
staff.superAdminNoBranch: A super admin works across every branch.
staff.formIncomplete: Fill in the name, a valid WhatsApp number and, for a librarian, the branch.
staff.tempBody: Give this to the person in private. It is shown only now and cannot be seen again. They must choose their own password when they first sign in.

errors.invalid_credentials: That WhatsApp number and password do not match.
errors.account_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes, or ask a librarian to reset your password.
errors.application_rejected: Your application was not approved. Please contact your branch.
errors.account_deactivated: This account has been deactivated. Please contact the library.
errors.must_change_password: Please choose a new password before continuing.
errors.wrong_current_password: Your current password is not correct.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.password_not_acceptable: Choose a password that meets the rules below.
errors.phone_in_use: An account already uses this WhatsApp number.
errors.minimum_super_admins: At least two super admin accounts must stay active.
errors.cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.use_change_password: Use "Change password" for your own account.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.invalid_request: Some of the information is missing or not valid.
errors.network_error: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.image_type: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.image_too_large: The image must be 2 MB or smaller.
errors.image_unreadable: That image could not be read.
errors.branch_code_in_use: Another branch already uses this code.
errors.branch_code_locked: This code is printed on books and can no longer change.
errors.category_code_in_use: Another category already uses this code.
errors.category_code_locked: Books already carry this code, so it can no longer change. The name can.
errors.members_only: Only members have a membership record.
errors.not_pending: This application has already been decided.
errors.not_rejected: Only an application that was not approved can be reopened.
errors.waiver_super_admin_only: Only a super admin can waive the first fee.
errors.cannot_renew: Approve the application first; then the membership can be renewed.
errors.invalid_date_of_birth: The date of birth must be in the past.
errors.title_not_found: That book is not in the catalogue.
errors.category_retired: That category is retired; choose another.
errors.copy_on_loan: This copy is on loan; take it back first.
errors.same_branch: The copy is already at that branch.
errors.merge_into_self: An entry cannot be merged into itself.
errors.title_merged: One of these entries has already been merged.
errors.copy_missing: This copy is recorded as missing.
errors.copy_not_useable: This copy is recorded as not useable.
errors.copy_other_branch: This copy belongs to another branch. Members borrow at their home branch.
errors.member_pending: The application has not been approved yet.
errors.member_expired: The membership has expired; the annual fee is due first.
errors.member_overdue_one: The member is holding an overdue book; it must come back first.
errors.member_overdue_other: The member is holding {{count}} overdue books; they must come back first.
errors.member_at_limit: The member already has {{max}} books, the most allowed.
errors.member_other_branch: That member belongs to another branch.
errors.no_open_loan: This copy is not on loan.
errors.already_returned: This book has already been taken back.
errors.loan_open: This book is still out; take it back at the counter instead.
errors.return_before_issue: A book cannot come back before it was issued.
errors.invalid_loan_dates: A book cannot come back before it was issued.
errors.date_in_future: That date has not happened yet.
errors.backdate_too_old: Paper slips can be entered up to 7 days back.
errors.nothing_to_change: Nothing is different from what the loan already says.
errors.import_has_errors: Some rows still need correcting; check the file again.
errors.duplicates_unreviewed: Decide every probable duplicate before importing.
errors.bad_decision: A decision does not match the file. Check the file again and decide afresh.
errors.export_too_large: {{count}} entries match, but one file can carry {{limit}}. Narrow the dates or the filter.

images.rules: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It is resized and kept inside the system.

branches.title: Branches
branches.lead: Every branch of the library, with its two-letter code.
branches.readOnly: Only a super admin can change these details.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.codeHint: Two capital letters, e.g. KS. It is printed on every book of this branch.
branches.codeLocked: Books already carry this code, so it can no longer change.
branches.formIncomplete: Fill in every field: a two-letter code and a valid phone number.
branches.logoUse: Shown to this branch's members and staff, and on its PDFs. Without one, the library's logo is used.
branches.settingsLead: Changes apply from now on, and are written to the activity log with the old and new values.
branches.settingsReadOnly: Only a super admin can change the settings.

loanDays.label: Loan period (days)
loanDays.hint: Also the length of an extension.

maxBooks.label: Books at a time
maxBooks.hint: The most one member may hold.

maxBooksWhileSettling.label: Books while a loss is open
maxBooksWhileSettling.hint: While a lost book is not yet settled.

holdDays.label: Hold a requested book (days)
holdDays.hint: After it arrives from another branch.

declineGraceDays.label: Grace after a late decline (days)
declineGraceDays.hint: When an extension is declined after the due date.

annualFeeCents.label: Annual fee
annualFeeCents.hint: For payments taken from now on.

renewalGraceDays.label: Renewal grace (days)
renewalGraceDays.hint: Renewing within this keeps the old expiry date.

settlementWindowDays.label: Days to settle a lost book

frequentLateCount.label: Late returns to flag a member

logRetentionMonths.label: Keep the log online (months)
logRetentionMonths.hint: At least 24; older entries are archived, never destroyed.

categories.title: Categories
categories.lead: The letter and digit in every accession number, each with a name members see.
categories.name: Name
categories.codeLocked: Books already carry this code, so it can no longer change. The name can.
categories.formIncomplete: A code is one capital letter and one digit, such as A1, and needs a name.

person.whatsappHint: You will sign in with this number.
person.organisationHint: For example the school you attend.
person.introducerHint: Someone who knows you and whom the library may call.

apply.title: Apply for membership
apply.lead: Fill this in at home. Then visit your branch with proof of identity and the first year’s fee; a librarian will approve you there.
apply.consent: The person who introduced me has agreed to be named and contacted by the library.
apply.privacyBody: The library keeps the details on this form to run your membership, and shows them only to its staff. If your application is not approved within 90 days, your details are removed. (Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022.)
apply.privacyAccept: I have read this and agree.
apply.incomplete: Please fill in every required field: a valid WhatsApp number, your date of birth, your home branch, and the introducer’s name and phone.

members.title: Members
members.lead: Applications to approve, finding a member, and memberships to renew.
members.searchPlaceholder: Part of a name, or a phone number
members.approveLead: With the applicant here: check their identity document against these details, then take the first year’s fee.
members.identityChecked: I have checked an identity document against these details.
members.rejectReason: Why is this application not approved?
members.rejectedNotice: The application was not approved. The person has been told when they next sign in.
members.feeIncomplete: Enter the amount and the receipt number.
members.reopenLead: It goes back to the waiting list. Personal details are removed 90 days after it was made.
members.renewLead: The membership runs until {{date}}. A year is added from that date, or from today if it lapsed long ago.
members.renewedNotice: Payment recorded. The membership now runs until {{date}}.
members.resetLead: Gives a temporary password, shown once, that must be changed at the next sign-in.
members.exportNote: Every export is written to the activity log.
members.registerLead: For someone who is here at the counter. They are a member at once, with a temporary password.
members.consentAsked: The person confirms their introducer agreed to be named.
members.registerIncomplete: Fill in every required field, tick both boxes, and enter the fee and receipt number.

my.title: My membership
my.lead: Your details as the library holds them. You can change your address, other phone and organisation here.
my.pendingLead: Your application, as the library will see it. You can correct it until it is approved.
my.otherChanges: To change your name, date of birth or WhatsApp number, ask a librarian.
my.overdueBody: Please bring it back. Until then you cannot borrow another book.
my.lateReturns_one: {{count}} late return in the last {{months}} months.
my.lateReturns_other: {{count}} late returns in the last {{months}} months.

catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.lead: Every book the library holds. Your home branch is shown first; choose another branch or all of them.
catalogue.searchPlaceholder: Title, writer, ISBN or book number (KS-A1-01234)
catalogue.onShelfOnly: Only books on the shelf now

titles.categoryHint: Changing it does not change the numbers already on the books.
titles.savedEverywhere: Saved. The correction shows at every branch.
titles.invalid: Fill in the title and category; an ISBN has 10 or 13 digits.
titles.moveHint: For good. The number printed on the book stays the same.
titles.howManyHint: Each gets its own number. Use 0 to add copies later.
titles.sourceHint: Purchase, donation, or the donor’s name.
titles.addedCopies: Added. Write these numbers on the books: {{numbers}}
titles.copiesInvalid: Choose a branch, a number of copies from 1 to 50, and a price in rupees if any.
titles.newLead: Enter the book once; then say how many copies your branch has. The system gives each copy its number.
titles.writeNumbers: Write these numbers on the books:
titles.maybeDuplicate: This book may already be in the catalogue
titles.duplicateHint: If it is the same book, open it and add copies there instead.
titles.mergeLead: If this is the same book as another entry, merge it into that one. Its copies move there; their numbers stay.
titles.mergedInto: This entry was merged into another.

counter.title: Counter
counter.lead: Lend a book, or take one back.
counter.accessionHint: As printed on the book, for example KS-A1-01234. The hyphens may be left out.
counter.badAccession: That is not a book number. It looks like KS-A1-01234.
counter.willBePaper: Entered from paper: borrowed on {{from}}, due back on {{date}}.
counter.paper: Entering a paper slip from an outage (up to {{days}} days back)
counter.lateBody: It was due on {{date}}. The late return is kept on the member's record; there is no fine.
counter.notUseable: It came back damaged: set it aside as not useable instead of shelving it

loans.title: Books
loans.paperHint: Entered later from a paper slip, with its real date
loans.overdueBody: Nothing more can be borrowed until it is back.
loans.frequentlyLateBody: {{count}} late returns in the last {{months}} months. This blocks nothing; it is for your judgement.
loans.correctLead: For a wrong book number, member or date. The old values and your reason are kept in the log.
loans.borrowedHint: The due date moves with it.
loans.undoReturn: It was not taken back: undo the take-back
loans.changeMember: Wrong member? Find the right one
loans.voidLead: Only for a loan entered entirely by mistake. It stays on the record, marked void, and counts nowhere.

panel.title: For your attention
panel.quiet: Nothing needs your attention. Enjoy your books.

suspended.title: Your membership is suspended
suspended.body: You cannot borrow until it is lifted. Please speak to the librarian at your branch.

overdue.body: It was due back on {{date}} ({{accession}}). Nothing more can be borrowed until it is returned.

expired.title: Your membership has expired
expired.body: It ended on {{date}}. Renew it at your branch to borrow again.

dueSoon.body: Due on {{date}} ({{accession}}). If you need it longer, ask at your branch before then.

expiring.body: It runs until {{date}}. Renew it at your branch to keep borrowing.

lateReturns.title_one: {{count}} late return in the last {{months}} months
lateReturns.title_other: {{count}} late returns in the last {{months}} months
lateReturns.body: Bringing books back on time keeps them moving for everyone.

application.title: Your application is waiting for approval
application.body: Visit the {{branch}} branch with proof of identity. A librarian will check your details and approve your membership there.
application.bodyFee: Visit the {{branch}} branch with proof of identity and the first year's fee, Rs {{fee}}. A librarian will check your details and approve your membership there.

due.title: Due and overdue books
due.lead: Overdue books first, then everything due soon. Click a column heading to sort.

calls.title: Call list
calls.lead: Members holding overdue books, the longest overdue first. Nothing is sent by the system: call or message each person by hand.
calls.none: Nobody is holding an overdue book.

standing.suspendedBody: This member cannot borrow, request or extend until a super admin lifts the suspension.
standing.pendingBody: Not yet a member: approve the application before lending anything.
standing.lateReturns_one: {{count}} late return in the last {{months}} months.
standing.lateReturns_other: {{count}} late returns in the last {{months}} months.

import.title: Import the old catalogue
import.lead: A one-off: the books already on the shelves get new numbers and new spine labels. Their old numbers are kept, so the old card index still matches.
import.how1: One row per physical book: two copies of the same book are two rows. Copies are grouped into titles for you.
import.how2: Columns (the first row holds their names): {{columns}}. Only title and category are needed; category is the new code, such as A1.
import.how3: In Excel, save it as "CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)" so that Sinhala and Tamil come through.
import.fileHint: A .csv file of at most 5 MB (about 20,000 books).
import.chooseFile: Choose the branch and the file first.

fileErrors.empty: It has no rows under the heading row.
fileErrors.not_utf8: It is not saved as UTF-8. In Excel choose "Save as" and "CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)".
fileErrors.too_many_rows: It has more than 20,000 rows. Split it into smaller files.
fileErrors.missing_column: The heading row has no column for: {{columns}}.

import.errorsLead: Correct these in the spreadsheet, save it, and check the file again. Nothing is imported until every row is right.

errors.bad_isbn: {{value}} is not an ISBN (10 or 13 digits).
errors.bad_price: {{value}} is not an amount in rupees.
errors.old_number_repeated: Old number {{value}} is used on an earlier line too.
errors.old_number_exists: Old number {{value}} has already been imported at this branch.
errors.category_differs: Another copy of this book has a different category ({{value}} here). Copies of one title share one category.

import.reviewLead: These may be a book the library already has, or the same book written two ways in the file. Decide each one.
import.restAreNew_one: The {{count}} undecided one is a different book
import.asNew: A different book: make it a new title
import.ready: {{copies}} copies will be numbered. {{titles}} titles have no probable duplicate.
import.doneBody: {{created}} new titles; copies added to {{added}} titles the library already had.
import.nextSteps: Print the new spine labels and put each on its book; the old number is printed small on each label to help. Keep the list of old and new numbers with the card index.
import.more_one: And {{count}} more in the downloaded list.
import.more_other: And {{count}} more in the downloaded list.

log.title: Activity log
log.leadAdmin: Everything done at your branch, newest first. Nothing here can be changed or deleted.
log.leadSuper: Everything done at every branch, newest first. Nothing here can be changed or deleted.
log.personHint: Or select a name in the list.
log.readNote: Each new search, export and history you open is itself written to the log, so others can see who looked.
log.badFilter: Some of the filter is not valid.
log.badRange: The start date is after the end date.
log.needKind: Choose the kind of record for a record number.
log.historyNote: Every change to this record, from the activity log. Opening it is recorded.

super_admin.server_reset: Super admin password reset on the server
